query:
SELECT cp.id, cp.paidDate, cp.paidAmount, cp.paymentMethod, cp.notes
FROM customerPayments cp
JOIN partners p ON cp.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%' AND cp.paidAmount = 0.50;
